name: Dr. Ameet Aggarwal, ND
reason: His own site (drameet.com, 5 Nov 2026) is a naturopathic medicine practice sold on conditions: its home page offers remedies and programmes for anxiety, depression, OCD, leaky gut, autoimmune issues, thyroid, infertility, weight and trauma, and his book is Heal Your Body, Cure Your Mind. His work is mainly medical and clinical treatment, so almost nothing would pass the health-claim rule. Skipped under the health rule.
